mapping_rules: Preserve the one official NC04 coverage polygon as one source-area record.
Do not count a source-area polygon as accepted parcel progress.
No canonical parcel identifier or local spatial-join readback exists in the predecessor package, therefore accepted_count maps to 0.
Do not mutate or rewrite the predecessor package; apply correction only in this forward batch.

preservation_contract.note: Predecessor package did not materialize owner/partition/semantic_mode fields; this mapping assigns no replacement values.
